explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/814: Sauermann proved the conjecture with c_k ≫ 1/k³. The statement gives one absolute C > 0 such that for all k ≥ 2, n ≥ k−1 and G with at least the threshold number of edges there is a nonempty S with |S| ≤ (1 − C/k³)n and G[S] of minimum degree ≥ k. That is the uniform form of c_k ≫ 1/k³. Faithful.
